en.headline: Police arrest five over 19 village-house burglaries linked to illegal entrants
en.dek: A New Territories North crime unit dismantled a gang targeting quiet village houses near hillsides, with total losses of about HK$2.1 million; two suspects are alleged illegal immigrants.
body: Police in New Territories North have arrested five people in connection with a series of burglaries at 19 village houses in Tuen Mun, Yuen Long and Tai Po, with total losses estimated at about HK$2.1 million.

Investigators said the group specialised in quiet, hillside village houses with weak security, entering in the evening when owners were often out. Officers analysed extensive closed-circuit television footage, including cameras under the Sharp Eye scheme, and identified a three-person core active for at least three months. A 53-year-old local man is alleged to have been the leader, transporting two suspected illegal immigrants from the mainland and directing them to scout and break into properties.

In a raid early on 8 August, officers arrested the two suspected illegal immigrants and a mainland woman on a two-way permit at a temporary structure in Tuen Mun, seizing burglary tools and clothing. The alleged leader and his girlfriend were arrested at a village house in the same district, where some stolen property and suspected drug-taking paraphernalia were recovered. The five, aged 29 to 53, face charges including burglary, illegal entry, conspiracy to burgle and related offences. Police urged residents to lock doors and windows when leaving home and to consider additional security measures.

zh.headline: 警拘5人涉19村屋爆竊 損失約210萬 主腦疑安排人蛇犯案
zh.dek: 新界北總區刑事總部瓦解活躍於屯門、元朗、大埔的村屋爆竊團伙，涉案19個單位總損失約210萬元，兩名疑犯懷疑非法入境。
body: 警方新界北總區刑事總部搗破一個活躍於屯門、元朗及大埔的村屋爆竊團伙，拘捕5人，涉案村屋單位共19個，總損失約港幣210萬元，最大單一案件損失約35萬元。
警方指團伙專門針對僻靜、鄰近山邊、保安薄弱的村屋，趁屋主傍晚外出時以工具撬門窗或沿未上鎖門窗入屋，偷取金器、首飾及現金。人員翻查大量閉路電視片段，包括「銳眼計劃」下的鏡頭，鎖定一個活躍至少3個月的3人核心，其中一名53歲本地男子涉嫌為主腦，以車輛接載兩名懷疑非法入境的內地男子並指使他們踩線及犯案。
8月8日凌晨，警方在屯門虎地一鐵皮屋拘捕兩名懷疑非法入境男子及一名持雙程證內地女子，檢獲爆竊工具及衣物；其後在楊小坑村村屋拘捕主腦及其女友，起回部分贓物及懷疑吸毒工具。5名被捕人士年齡介乎29至53歲，涉嫌爆竊、非法入境、串謀爆竊等罪名。警方呼籲市民外出時鎖好門窗，避免存放貴重物品，並考慮加裝防盜及閉路電視系統。
